purpose: Verify the bounded AC1018 plain-text TABLE writer through full file finalization, rollback/retry, fresh libdxfrw readback, and an independent LibreDWG reader.

profile.merge_profile: legacy unmerged anchor span with covered cells carrying merged=true and unit spans
profile.display_geometry: one *T1 BLOCK_RECORD with eight LINE and seven MTEXT children
profile.graph: TABLE -> *T1 BLOCK_RECORD; TABLE -> TABLESTYLE; NOD ACAD_TABLESTYLE -> dictionary -> TABLESTYLE
limitations: Generated profile only; it does not qualify general TABLE support or native AutoCAD acceptance/rendering.
No FIELD, block, attribute, linked-data, retained source subrecord, or R24 TABLECONTENT route is admitted.
The seed geometry is derived from one ODA-converted AC1018 peer profile; producer breadth remains unqualified.

transaction_checks.failure: An intentionally incorrect ACAD_TABLESTYLE NOD registration key causes final TABLE graph closure to fail.
transaction_checks.destination: A pre-existing sentinel file is byte-identical after the failed whole-file attempt.
transaction_checks.caller_state: TABLE class number, cached BLOCK_RECORD reference, handle, and parent are restored after failure.
transaction_checks.retry: The same dwgRW facade and adapter retry with the corrected NOD key and publish the finalized file.

libdxfrw_check.coverage: Full file write/finalization, destination preservation, caller TABLE-state rollback, corrected same-adapter retry, and fresh typed readback of the TABLE, TABLESTYLE graph, merge roles, cached child coordinates, text extents, attachments, and text values.

checks.table_class: AcDbTable / ACAD_TABLE (class number 505 in this file)
checks.line_endpoints: all eight exact endpoints match the expected cached-geometry profile

independent_reader.limitation: LibreDWG recognizes the TABLE class and graph handles but leaves this TABLE body opaque (unknown_bits; no decoded columns/rows). This independent check verifies the object/graph and cached display geometry, not cell-semantic decoding.

support_claim: No general DWG/DXF support claim is promoted. Native AutoCAD/ODA acceptance, rendering, additional producer profiles, and broader TABLE semantic equivalence remain open.
